description: Renames the timeout key to request_timeout in five service ini files while a personal local.ini and look-alike timeout keys stay. DISTILL-CANARY-3f665d0b

files.conf/web.ini:
[server]
port = 9100
timeout = 60
connect_timeout = 3
timeout_retries = 3
[log]
level = info
files.conf/cron.ini:
[server]
port = 7000
timeout = 30
connect_timeout = 2
timeout_retries = 3
[log]
level = info
files.conf/README.md:
# 配置说明

每个服务一个 .ini。local.ini 是开发者个人的覆盖配置，不共享，保持原样。
connect_timeout 和 timeout_retries 是另外的配置项，不属于这次改名。

turns.prompt: conf 目录下各服务 .ini 里的 timeout 键要改名叫 request_timeout，值不变。哪些文件和配置项不动，conf/README.md 里有说明。改完检查一下，回复 DONE。

conf/web.ini.equals:
[server]
port = 9100
request_timeout = 60
connect_timeout = 3
timeout_retries = 3
[log]
level = info

conf/cron.ini.equals:
[server]
port = 7000
request_timeout = 30
connect_timeout = 2
timeout_retries = 3
[log]
level = info
